service.name: Cosmic Exploration Boost
service.longDescription: Among the stars, every tool tells a story — from Cosmic to Stars, plus the 500K-tracker Vacuum Suit for those who master all eleven jobs. Piloted through every stellar mission.

rewards.title: Cosmic Tools at Any Stage
rewards.text: Cosmic, Stellar, Hypertool or Stars tools for any DoH or DoL job — pick exactly the stages you need.

rewards.title: High Mobility Vacuum Suit Mount
rewards.text: — 500K Cosmic Tracker on all 11 DoH and DoL jobs.

rewards.title: Cosmic Credits & Materials Kept
rewards.text: Credits, scrips and every material earned along the way stays on your character.

rewards.title: Achievement Unlocked
rewards.text: Achievements unlocked upon completing the Cosmic Tool stages.

accordion.title: Requirements
items: Have any DoH or DoL job at level 100
Cosmic Exploration unlocked (available as an additional service)
